title: Hybrid Job Optimization
description: Ask which prod jobs waste capacity or money, and why, using system tables plus Watchtower driver logs.

tables.description: One row per prod job over the last 30 days: list cost, DBUs, runs, failed runs, avg minutes, clusters per run, worker CPU/memory/swap, OOM/spill/lost-executor/error counts from logs, and one prioritized top_recommendation.
Append-only daily snapshot per job (snapshot_date): cost, utilization, log signals and run health. Use for trends and before/after comparisons of a change.
Per job per day: oom_events, spill_events, lost_executor_events, error_lines and runs_with_logs, parsed from driver logs by Watchtower.
Per job per day: worker-node avg_cpu, p95_cpu, avg_mem, max_swap (percent) and number of clusters.
Parsed driver log lines from Watchtower: cluster_id, log_source (stdout/stderr/log4j), log_level, log_ts, log_msg. Join to ops.v_job_cluster_map on cluster_id to get job_id and job_run_id.
Maps cluster_id to job_id and job_run_id (last 90 days).

instructions: All data is from the prod workspace. Costs are list price in USD, not the negotiated rate.
CPU and memory are worker-node percentages. p95_cpu below 40 with avg_mem below 50 means oversized.
oom_events, spill_events and lost_executor_events come from driver logs parsed by Watchtower.
Show job_name, not job_id, in answers. 'Last month' means the last 30 days.
For trends over time, or comparing before and after a change, use job_daily_history.
To show log lines for a job, join silver.logs to ops.v_job_cluster_map on cluster_id and filter by job name via v_job_scorecard_30d.
sample_questions: Which 10 jobs cost the most in the last 30 days, and what is the top recommendation for each?
Which jobs had out-of-memory events last week?
List oversized jobs ordered by cost.
Which jobs start more than one cluster per run?
Show daily cost and average runtime for the most expensive job over the last 90 days.
Show the last 50 ERROR log lines for the most expensive failing job.
